pain_points.name: Patient No-Shows
pain_points.description: Patients miss appointments without canceling, leading to lost revenue and scheduling gaps
pain_points.impact: 15-20% of appointments result in no-shows, costing €500-1000/day in lost revenue
pain_points.ai_potential: Automated multi-channel reminders reduce no-shows by 30-50%

pain_points.name: Low Treatment Acceptance
pain_points.description: Patients decline recommended treatment due to cost, fear, or poor communication
pain_points.impact: Only 30-50% of treatment plans are accepted, leaving significant revenue on table
pain_points.ai_potential: Visual treatment simulators and financing options increase acceptance by 20-30%

pain_points.name: Recall/Recare Compliance
pain_points.description: Patients don't return for regular cleanings and checkups
pain_points.impact: 40-60% of patients are overdue for hygiene visits
pain_points.ai_potential: Automated personalized recall campaigns recover 15-25% of lapsed patients

pain_points.name: Insurance Administration Burden
pain_points.description: Verifying benefits, submitting claims, handling denials takes significant staff time
pain_points.ai_potential: Real-time eligibility verification and AI claim scrubbing reduce denials by 20-30%

key_metrics.name: Production per Provider Hour
key_metrics.description: Revenue generated per hour of provider time
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Optimize scheduling, reduce no-shows, increase case acceptance

key_metrics.name: Hygiene Reappointment Rate
key_metrics.description: Percentage of hygiene patients who schedule their next cleaning before leaving
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Pre-book next appointment, automated reminders, membership programs

key_metrics.name: Case Acceptance Rate
key_metrics.description: Percentage of treatment plans that are accepted and scheduled
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Visual presentations, financing options, treatment coordinator training

key_metrics.name: New Patient Flow
key_metrics.description: Number of new patients per month
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Online booking, reputation management, SEO optimization

key_metrics.name: No-Show/Cancellation Rate

key_metrics.how_to_improve: Automated reminders, confirmation texting, waitlist management
